chapterName: Unlawful Discrimination in Employment, Public Accommodations and Real Property Transactions; Administrative and Civil Enforcement
reviewBasis: Read directly from the frozen source's own plain text (markup stripped with no section-segmentation logic applied) and cross-checked against the raw HTML markup, using the same auditable-script method validated on chapters 105, 183 and 471: every ... run matching a bare section-number-plus-heading pattern was extracted directly from the frozen source, independent of parse_ors_chapter.py. All 160 resulting operative catchlines were cross-checked against the chapter's own printed table of contents -- 160/160 matched, zero extra, zero missing. The remaining 3 sections omitted from the table of contents were found by a second script pass over the body text for bare section numbers immediately followed by a bracketed legislative-history citation (this being a comparatively modern chapter -- 659A was itself created in 2001 by renumbering the old chapter 659 -- far fewer stubs survive than in the older chapters 105, 183 and 471). This is the fifth and final chapter of increment 5's frozen gold selection.

methodology.catchlineExtractionMethod: auditable script over raw <b> markup, not parse_ors_chapter.py
methodology.stubDetectionMethod: auditable script matching bare section number + bracketed legislative-history citation, manually inspected
